action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -c '
echo "=== app processes ==="
ps aux | grep -E "forego|puma 8|vite.js|websocket-server|background-worker|dartsass" | grep -v grep | awk "{print \$11,\$12,\$13,\$14,\$15}"
echo "=== listening ports inside container ==="
(ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null) | grep -E ":(3000|3036|6042)\b" | awk "{print \$4}"
' 2>&1
